summary: Repaired node1’s fixed-width importer, generated CSV and rejects output, preserved the original input, and verified persistence after a safe node restart.
actions_performed: Replaced whitespace splitting with fixed-width parsing for 5-character ID, 12-character name, and 4-digit quantity.
Preserved leading-zero IDs and leading name whitespace while trimming only right-hand space padding.
Added rejection of incorrect-length and nonnumeric-quantity records with source line numbers.
Removed temporary bytecode and test artifacts.
Restarted node1 safely and verified recovery.

evidence.summary: CSV contains 00007,Paper,0042 and 00100,Tape,0008. Edge testing confirms leading spaces are retained, right padding is removed, and CSV quoting works.

evidence.requirement: Reject malformed records with line numbers
evidence.summary: rejects.txt contains the nonnumeric quantity record as line 3 and the short record as line 4.

evidence.requirement: Preserve original input and installed platform
evidence.summary: input.dat retained its original SHA-256 36cd3f4d… and timestamp. RHEL 10.0 and kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0.x86_64 remained unchanged.

Healthy baseline boot ID d9f8550d-5cb3-4929-9e62-a388df86bcf6 was captured; safe reboot was acknowledged; post-restart boot ID changed to 04fb95ed-75c7-4dda-9cec-cfc4f2093b80. System state returned to running and the importer reproduced persisted CSV and rejects exactly.
